preconditions.name: Literal A666 route binding
preconditions.how_verified_read_only: Read the active profile and runner preflight; require exact equality with pftl-a666-ethereum-wA666-usdc-v1.

preconditions.name: Live endpoint binding
preconditions.how_verified_read_only: Read the active profile endpoints; require Ethereum mainnet chain_id 1 and Arbitrum chain_id 42161, with no Sepolia, testnet, Anvil, fork, or local_l4 endpoint.

preconditions.name: StakeHub preservation
preconditions.how_verified_read_only: Read service state and account balances; verify all five StakeHub services and funds remain preserved before any leg.

preconditions.name: Historical bridge-packet supersession
preconditions.how_verified_read_only: Read the restored runner selection and historical leg1-mainnet-cctp-pftl-held.json; verify only this literal-A666 packet is selected.

abort_conditions: active service/profile identity differs from the reviewed packet
warm service or fleet is unavailable
literal asset/route/contract differs from the packet
cap projection exceeds the configured cap
existing receipt indicates a replay or already-completed substep
endpoint is Sepolia, testnet, Anvil, fork, or local_l4
a live command has no committed RED-first regression and reviewed HELD packet
the principal decision or packet-hash confirmation is missing
the restored canonical runner and old packet would both be run, creating double-bridge risk

surfaces.substep: A: mainnet USDC to Arbitrum native USDC
B: Arbitrum ingress to PFTL pfUSDC

supersession_rule: This packet supersedes the historical packet for the literal A666 route; never run both a restored canonical runner and the historical packet.
